title: Isometric feature grid
description: A big headline and lead beside a 2 × 2 grid of features, each with a detailed isometric drawing on a warm paper tile, framed by crop marks.

import type { ComponentProps, CSSProperties, ReactNode } from "react";

import { Separator } from "@/components/ui/separator";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

/* ── Colour ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * A fixed warm palette, light only: paper, ink and one orange in the
 * drawings. Set on the section's root, so a className or style can swap any
 * of them. Two text colours are a step darker than the design's, to pass
 * contrast on the paper: the intro (large text) at 3.2:1 and the small mono
 * labels at 4.6:1. */

  "--fs3-body": "#6B6357",
  "--fs3-dot": "#DFD8CB",
  "--fs3-guide": "#C6BDAD",
  "--fs3-ink": "#1F1B16",
  "--fs3-intro": "#8B8377",
  "--fs3-label": "#716A5E",
  "--fs3-paper": "#F2EEE7",
  "--fs3-tile": "#E8E2D7",
} as CSSProperties;

/* ── Guides and marks ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

/* A dashed guide line (1px dash, 3px gap): shadcn's Separator, its solid
 * fill swapped for the dash pattern here at the call site. */
const Guide = ({
  className,
  orientation = "horizontal",
}: {
  className?: string;
  orientation?: "horizontal" | "vertical";
}) => (
  <Separator
    className={cn(
      "pointer-events-none absolute bg-transparent",
      orientation === "vertical"
        ? "bg-[repeating-linear-gradient(to_bottom,var(--fs3-guide)_0_1px,transparent_1px_4px)]"
        : "bg-[repeating-linear-gradient(to_right,var(--fs3-guide)_0_1px,transparent_1px_4px)]",
      className
    )}
    orientation={orientation}
  />
);

/* A crop mark: one L, turned for each corner of a drawing's frame. */
const CornerMark = ({ className }: { className?: string }) => (
  <svg
    aria-hidden="true"
    className={cn("pointer-events-none absolute size-3", className)}
    fill="none"
    height="12"
    viewBox="0 0 12 12"
    width="12"
  >
    <path d="M0.5 12 V0.5 H12" stroke="var(--fs3-guide)" />
  </svg>
);

const CORNERS = [
  "top-0 left-1",
  "top-0 right-1 rotate-90",
  "bottom-0 right-1 rotate-180",
  "bottom-0 left-1 -rotate-90",

 * Isometric line art on a 440 × 440 canvas (the tile it sits on): 1.2px ink
 * edges, faces in paper shades and one orange object per scene. */

            >
              {badge && (
                <span className="absolute top-[0.155em] left-0 size-[0.88em] [&>svg]:size-full">
                  {badge}
                </span>
              )}
              {heading}
            </HeadingTag>
          </div>

          <div className="relative">
            {/* intro */}
            <div className="relative px-5 pb-10 sm:px-6 lg:pt-20">
              <p className="font-sans text-[1.5rem] leading-[1.25] font-medium tracking-[-0.03em] text-pretty text-(--fs3-intro) sm:text-[2rem] lg:mt-6 lg:text-[2.125rem] xl:text-[2.5rem] min-[100rem]:text-[3rem]">
                {intro}
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* features */}
            <ul className="relative grid sm:grid-cols-2">
              <Guide className="inset-x-0 top-0" />
              {features.map((feature, index) => (
                <li
                  className="relative px-4 pt-6 pb-8 sm:px-6 sm:pt-7.5 sm:pb-6"
                  key={feature.id}
                >
                  <Guide className="inset-x-0 bottom-0" />
                  {index % 2 === 0 && (
                    <Guide
                      className="inset-y-0 right-0 hidden sm:block"
                      orientation="vertical"
                    />
                  )}
                  <div className="relative px-6 py-4.5">
                    {CORNERS.map((corner) => (
                      <CornerMark className={corner} key={corner} />
                    ))}
                    <div className="aspect-square overflow-hidden rounded-[8.2%] bg-(--fs3-tile) [&>svg]:size-full">
                      {feature.art}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="relative mt-5">
                    <span className="absolute top-2.5 left-1 font-mono text-xs leading-none tracking-[0.05em] text-(--fs3-label)">
                      {String(index + 1).padStart(2, "0")}
                    </span>
                    <TitleTag className="font-sans text-[1.375rem] leading-[1.25] font-medium tracking-[-0.025em] text-pretty indent-[2.6em] sm:text-[1.5rem] lg:text-[1.625rem]">
                      {feature.title}
                    </TitleTag>
                    <p className="mt-5 max-w-[28.25rem] font-sans text-base leading-[1.6] text-(--fs3-body) lg:text-[1.0625rem]">
                      {feature.description}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
};

export default FeatureSection03;
